verdict.rationale: The Drive API reference shows a versioned endpoint (v3) confirming API versioning exists (google-drive-docs-5), but the evidence pack contains no documentation of a deprecation policy, sunset schedule, or changelog for API versions, and probes for llms.txt/openapi specs return 404s. missing for 10: documented deprecation/sunset policy, version lifecycle timeline, changelog or migration guide, independent confirmation of deprecation practices.
